```{r setup, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("readr")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("tidyr")

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
raw_data <- read_csv("color.csv")

```
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
heatmap_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(color, Emotion) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    color = reorder(color, Mean_Score, FUN = mean),
    Emotion = reorder(Emotion, Mean_Score, FUN = mean)
  )

ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = color, y = Emotion, fill = Mean_Score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ebf3fb", high = "#004085") + 
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Color-Emotion Associations",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20) 
  )

ggsave("heatmap_final_corrected.png", width = 15, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

error_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(color == "white", Emotion == "sadness") %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    se_score = sd_score / sqrt(n),    Country = reorder(Country, -Mean_Score)
  )

ggplot(error_data, aes(x = Country, y = Mean_Score)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Score - se_score, ymax = Mean_Score + se_score), 
                width = 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5), expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sadness Intensity for White: Cultural Comparison",
    subtitle = "Error bars represent the Standard Error (SE)",
    x = NULL, 
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, color = "grey30", face = "plain"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8)
  )

ggsave("white_sadness_descending.png", width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```



```{r stackedbar, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

barplot_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(color == "red", Emotion %in% c("love", "anger")) %>%
  group_by(Country, Emotion) %>%
  summarise(Total_Score = sum(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Total_Score / sum(Total_Score)) %>%
  ungroup()

love_ranks <- barplot_data %>%
  filter(Emotion == "love") %>%
  arrange(desc(Proportion)) %>%
  pull(Country)

barplot_data <- barplot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Country = factor(Country, levels = love_ranks),
    Emotion = factor(Emotion, levels = c("love", "anger"))
  )

ggplot(barplot_data, aes(x = Country, y = Proportion, fill = Emotion)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("love" = "firebrick", "anger" = "black")) +
  labs(
    title = "The Dual Nature of Red: Love and Anger",
    subtitle = NULL, 
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL 
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    
    legend.position = "right", 
    
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Proportion, accuracy = 1)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE), 
            color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5)

ggsave("red_love_anger_final_right_legend.png", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```



```{r}
global_intensity <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(color) %>%
  summarise(Overall_Mean = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(color = reorder(color, Overall_Mean))

ggplot(global_intensity, aes(x = color, y = Overall_Mean, fill = Overall_Mean)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d1e5f0", high = "#053061") + 
  labs(
    title = "Global Emotional Intensity of Colors",
    subtitle = NULL, # Alt başlık kaldırıldı
    x = NULL,        # "Color Name" kaldırıldı
    y = NULL         # "Average Intensity Score" kaldırıldı
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("global_color_intensity_large_clean.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
radar_data_black <- plot_data %>%
  filter(color == "black") %>%
  group_by(Emotion) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE))

sorted_levels <- radar_data_black %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_Score)) %>%
  pull(Emotion) %>%
  as.character()

idx_love <- which(sorted_levels == "love")
idx_joy  <- which(sorted_levels == "joy")
if(length(idx_love) > 0 && length(idx_joy) > 0) {
  sorted_levels[c(idx_love, idx_joy)] <- sorted_levels[c(idx_joy, idx_love)]
}

radar_data_black$Emotion <- factor(radar_data_black$Emotion, levels = sorted_levels)

ggplot(radar_data_black, aes(x = Emotion, y = Mean_Score, fill = Mean_Score)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  
  coord_polar(clip = "off") + 
  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#cccccc", high = "#000000") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + 

  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.7)) +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "The Emotional Depth of Black",
    subtitle = NULL, 
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", color = "black"), 
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", color = "black", margin = margin(b = 10), hjust = 0.5),
    
    plot.margin = margin(30, 30, 30, 30), 
    legend.position = "none" 
  )

ggsave("black_radar_final_centered.png", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
